not_a_verdict_note: subject_ref_origin_disclosed is a disclosure. It is not a verdict, not a ninth Boolean, and not a companion to chain_status. No value it can carry upgrades, downgrades, overrides, excuses, or replaces any of the eight Boolean verdicts or chain_status. It never appears inside the verdicts object, which remains closed at exactly eight Boolean members.
enum_membership_note: not_declared is not a member of the SRS envelope enum and does not appear in the envelope schema. It is the reader-and-report rendering of an absent field and is never an emitted receipt value. The envelope vocabulary is closed at the five declared values and carries no additional-value tolerance.
absence_semantics: An absent subject_ref_origin means the field was not declared, full stop. It supports no inference about emitter vintage, about the producing binding, or about whether a subject was in fact supplied. It is never collapsed into supplied_subject or into any other declared class. A v0.2.0-era receipt that predates the field is indistinguishable, for this purpose, from a v0.2.1-era receipt that declined to declare one.
malformed_value_rule: A present subject_ref_origin whose value is outside the five declared values -- including a present null, a non-string JSON type, or an unrecognized string -- is invalid input. It is rejected by the reader (arcs_verify.subject_ref_origin.MalformedSubjectRefOrigin) and, under the v0.2.1 envelope pin, also fails the envelope verdict on exact-membership rejection. It is never laundered into not_declared. Only true absence becomes not_declared.
reader_rules: Read subject_ref_origin from the validated receipt bytes handed to the verifier.
A valid declared field discloses the exact declared token, copied verbatim.
A genuinely absent field discloses not_declared.
A present malformed value is invalid input or an existing schema failure, never not_declared.
Do not infer origin from subject_ref, request identifiers, session identifiers, correlation shape, or emitter identity.
Do not import emitter code. The verifier continues to recompute every reported value from the receipt bytes independently.
parity_note: arcs_verify.dagr_report_v0_2.build_verification_report delegates to the frozen v0.1 builder and then restates report_version and report_contract_id and inserts subject_ref_origin_disclosed. There is no second verdict path, so v0.1/v0.2 parity on the eight Booleans, on chain_status, and on every hash field is structural rather than merely asserted.
